desc: The bundled pipeline seed covers play (players' reports: a hitch the first time Mario walked past a paper note or talked to someone, the releases carrying no seed): a fresh cache ({out}/cache) and the seed beside the build (data/initial_pipeline_cache.db, CMakeLists.txt), "Preparing graphics" waited for as on a player's first start (TTYD_WARMUP=1), to its end (TTYD_WARMUP_SECONDS: a player's is cut at 90 s; the cache folder made by the game), then Rogueport's harbour with a paper note under Mario's feet (TTYD_NOTES_TEST, no relay): he walks to the NPC over the note, its balloon shows, and he talks to him. No pipeline is built on demand after the warmup (Aurora 0081's log line); the warmup's time and count are in its [warmup] line
log_must: Seeded pipeline cache from '[^']*initial_pipeline_cache\.db' \([1-9]\d* rows merged
^\[warmup\] Preparing graphics done: [1-9]\d* pipelines built in \d+ ms \(\d+ queued at the start, 0 left,
^\[notes\] A by t0 was the game's: motion 14$
log_must_not: No bundled initial pipeline cache found
